name: NewTypeGroupDialog
intent: Create a type group: a required name, a description, and an optional members picker.
when: Grouping object types for navigation or ownership
Any small create flow with an optional membership step
whenNot: Declaring a contract types implement -> use NewInterfaceDialog

chooseOver.because: It carries the optional members block, so a host that has candidates offers them at creation time and one that does not simply omits the prop.

title.note: Dialog heading; defaults to the workforce wording.

objectTypes.note: Members offered at creation. Omitted means no Members block at all.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Drafts carry no id; the host mints one on accept.

states.withMembers: A members picker appears when objectTypes is supplied.

evaluationCriteria: Omitting objectTypes removes the Members block entirely rather than showing an empty one.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted in group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
notes: Already an exported component with a typed props interface and no fixture coupling — this manifest is the only thing that was missing.

usage: Use NewTypeGroupDialog when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
NewTypeGroupDialog should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading. Defaults to the workforce wording.

props.name: namePlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the name field, e.g. "e.g. Commercial & Cost".

props.name: objectTypes
props.description: Members to offer at creation time. Omitted -> no Members block (prototype parity for WC3).

anatomy.description: NewTypeGroupDialog is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: NewTypeGroupDialogTrigger
parts.description: Element that opens the dialog when activated.

parts.name: NewTypeGroupDialogContent
parts.description: Container for the dialog content and overlay.

parts.name: NewTypeGroupDialogHeader
parts.description: Header section containing title and description.
